summary.text: BOBILAGENTEN AS is a private limited company registered in Tiller, founded 2008-12-18. BOBILAGENTEN AS is registered for the sale (omsetning) of motorhomes and other vehicles, and its statutory purpose covers the sale of motor vehicles and caravans, including participation in other businesses with similar or related activity and what naturally goes together with this. Its main industry code is 47.810: retail sale of motor vehicles. The register shows 7 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 60 541 135 NOK and the annual result was 3 357 257 NOK; operating income was up from 47 900 773 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 2 994 049 NOK in 2024 to 3 357 257 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 17 983 007 NOK in 2024 to 18 740 264 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Kjell-Atle Småberg (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 5 on 2025-12-13 to 7 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
